literalInverseOperations.after:
sdk-original-obligations:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.target_validation_group == 'agent_sdk_session_only_proof' && inputs.exact_test_selector == 'HanlinSDKCancellationQuotaWidgets' && !inputs.testflight_upload }}
    name: Original SDK cancellation, payload ownership and affected Widget cases
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 90
    concurrency:
      group: hanlin-original-sdk-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Verify closed controller without Apple or native operations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/sdk-original-obligations
          set +e
          python3 -m unittest discover -s Scripts/CI/SDKSourceValidation -p 'test_control.py' -v > build/sdk-original-obligations/controller-tests.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          set -e
          cat build/sdk-original-obligations/controller-tests.log
          exit "$status"
      - name: Test the explicit immutable original package source
        env:
          HANLIN_SDK_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.composer_expected_sha }}
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
        run: python3 Scripts/CI/SDKSourceValidation/run.py
      - name: Preserve original source, locks, logs, products and every failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: hanlin-original-sdk-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: build/sdk-original-obligations
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
